Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "A Slight Lean" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the<ref name="A Slight Lean" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] celestial body<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Fait d'Fait system/Legends|Fait d'Fait system]]</ref> [[Fait d'Fait]]. The governor pursued strong anti-organized crime policies, and as a result several criminal syndicates sought the help of an off-worlder to help them make the [[Politics/Legends|politician]] reconsider his stance.<ref name="A Slight Lean" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one side of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to assist the criminals. The companion discovered embarrassing infromation about the governor that the grateful crime syndicates could use to manipulate him indefinitely.<ref name="A Slight Lean" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The governor of Fait d'Fait was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "A Slight Lean" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="A Slight Lean" />
